block.guhs.weer_vadser.lore: Makes its own weather, up to 100 blocks around. Right-click: pick a weather!
block.guhs.weer_vadser.lore.kracht: Needs %s vadskracht while it makes any weather but normal
item.guhs.weerpotje.gebruik: Right-click: the weather is yours for good, in every Weather Vadser
gui.guhs.weer.ontgrendeld: Unlocked: %s! Pick it in your Weather Vadser. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.weer.al_gehad: You already had %s, njeg! Give the jar to a friend.
gui.guhs.weer.op_slot: %s is still locked. Find its weather jar first!
gui.guhs.weer.uitgezet: The Weather Vadser is back to normal. Just weather, vads.
gui.guhs.weer.gekozen_slaapt: Weather: %s, but the Weather Vadser is napping: it needs %s vadskracht.
gui.guhs.weer.scherm.uit: Now: just the world's weather. Pick one!
gui.guhs.weer.scherm.slaapt: Zzz... the Weather Vadser needs %s vadskracht
gui.guhs.weer.slot_hint: Locked! You find its weather jar here: %s
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.normaal.uitleg: Just the world's own weather. The Weather Vadser takes a nap and asks no vadskracht.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.zon.uitleg: Nice and sunny, even when it rains everywhere else.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.regen.uitleg: Rain! In cold places it snows. Blubs jump in the puddles.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.onweer.uitleg: Rumble rumble! A flash now and then, but nobody gets hit and nothing catches fire.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.pluisjes.uitleg: Soft pink fluff drifts down. Guhs hop to catch it.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.bellen.uitleg: It rains soap bubbles! Blub-guhs love it and blow along.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.knabbel.uitleg: Now and then a cheese nibble drops from the sky. Not too many, vads.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.regenboog.uitleg: Soft sunny rain with a big rainbow. Guhs and Blubs dance in the puddles.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.hartjes.uitleg: Little hearts float down. Your tame guhs and Blubs get extra cuddly.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.sterren.uitleg: At night stars fall with glittering tails. Make a wish!
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.knusmist.uitleg: A soft pink fog. Everything gets cosy and the guhs get sleepy.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.bloesem.uitleg: Blossom petals blow by. Smells like the Bloesemmeertje.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.pluisjes.bron: chests in the Old Wool Mill and the Cloud Meadow's cloud chests
item.guhs.weerpotje_bellen.lore: A jar full of soap bubbles. Don't shake!
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.bellen.bron: chests in the Guh Bubble and in Bikini Bottom
item.guhs.weerpotje_knabbel.lore: Cheese nibbles under a little cloud. Mmm.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.knabbel.bron: the treasure chest of a Cheese Nibble Nest, or win the Nibble Games
item.guhs.weerpotje_regenboog.lore: A bit of rainbow with a little shower.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.regenboog.bron: the Travel Agency's souvenir 'Rainbow in a Jar', or a gold medal on the Guh Circuit
item.guhs.weerpotje_hartjes.lore: Hearts! The jar is warm when you hold it.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.hartjes.bron: chests at a Guh Picnic and a Surprise Party
item.guhs.weerpotje_sterren.lore: A bit of night sky with falling stars.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.sterren.bron: the Guh Observatory, the Star Cave, or connect a constellation with the telescope
item.guhs.weerpotje_knusmist.lore: Pink fog. Sniff it and you get sleepy.
item.guhs.weerpotje_bloesem.lore: Blossom petals that never stop blowing.
gui.guhs.weer.weertje.bloesem.bron: the chest on the Bloesemmeertje's picnic island
